title: Flash ad-hoc cost + contact matrix (mini decision sampler)
content:
Purpose:
This is a fast, lightweight spreadsheet for scoping one-off asks that affect serving cost or coverage. Goal is to get a triage decision (do it / delay / escalate) within 48 hours with a minimal cost delta estimate and named owner for follow-up. Use in cross-functional syncs and rapid handoffs.

How to use:
- Fill a row for each distinct ask (feature, customer incident, pilot, surge capacity request).
- Token impact is rough order-of-magnitude (tokens/day) based on current route patterns; use the QuickCalc section below if unsure.
- Priority is P0 (must do), P1 (high), P2 (nice-to-have).
- ETA is a realistic earliest ship date for a single owner taking on the task.
- Blockers are minimal — if more than 2 blockers, mark for escalation.

Table (rows are compact):
ID,Owner,Stakeholder Team,Ask (one line),Estimated Token Impact (tokens/day),Region,Priority,ETA,Blockers,Quick Decision / Next Action
1,Aisha Patel,product-hosted-api,Add per-route caching for /generate with 8k prefix whitelist,~2,500,000,global,P0,2026-08-17,needs infra quota + canary plan,Approve canary; eng-infra to allocate burst pool (Marco)
2,Marco Diaz,eng-platform-engineering,Increase Dedicated pool for SE pilot (2x GPUs for 48h),~350,000,us-west,P1,2026-08-12,contract sign-off + billing code,Short-run approve; finance notify (Priya)
3,Priya Singh,customer-success,Customer X trial needs region fallback to eu-west during outage,~75,000,eu-west,P0,2026-08-11,permission for private routing,Enable interim route + open PRODOPS-421 (Jamal)
4,Helen Brooks,observability,Add a lightweight surface for token/budget alerts per org,~0 (metering),global,P2,2026-09-01,UX mock needed,Backlog to Q4; assign to observability spike (Helen)
5,Jamal Rivers,solutions-engineering,One-off quantization test for small model (cost delta estimate),~120,000,us-east,P1,2026-08-20,bench infra + dataset scrub,Run quant pilot on dev cluster (Jamal)
6,External:Legal (contact Helen),security-and-compliance,Quick KMS approval for pilot telemetry export,N/A,us-east,P0,2026-08-13,legal sign-off required,Escalate to security lead; block until signed

QuickCalc methodology (very light):
- Estimate requests/day * avg tokens/request = tokens/day. If requests/day unknown, use sampling: take 1 hour window from prod-route, multiply by 24.
- Cost delta rough rule-of-thumb: 1M tokens/day on small/standard model ~ $30/day (hosted), adjust by model class. For Dedicated assume proportional GPU time; flag as "unknown" if uncertain.

Notes / assumptions:
- These are not full capacity requests. This sheet is for triage + short-run approval only. Any change expected to go >72h or >$1k/day must escalate to Dedicated capacity planning and finance.
- Region tags are minimal; if multi-region, list primary region.
- Owners listed are primary handoff owners — they should update ETA and blockers within 24 hours of assignment.

Recent decisions (from this sheet):
- Row 1: go ahead with canary caching; Marco to schedule burst pool and Aisha to draft rollback criteria by 2026-08-12.
- Row 3: temporary eu-west fallback enabled for Customer X; CS to monitor latency delta and report by 2026-08-14.

Open questions / discussion points:
- Should we automate token impact sampling as a quick query in Console? (low-effort analytics: 1 engineer => ~0.5 day).
- Do we want standardized thresholds for auto-approve (e.g., <100k tokens/day and P2)?

Action items (next 48h):
- Marco: allocate burst pool + post confirmation in linked slack thread.
- Priya: confirm billing pre-approval for SE pilot and add finance watcher.
- Jamal: start dataset scrub for quant test and open bench run issue.
- Aisha: update canary rollback criteria doc and link to this sheet.

Revision history:
- 2026-08-03 created (initial triage entries).
- 2026-08-05 added Row 6 (legal/KMS).
- 2026-08-10 updated ETAs after quick sync, marked Row 1 decision approved.

Appendix (short reference):
- Quick Slack thread: #ops-mini-surge (use for confirmations)
- Jira stub: PRODOPS-421 (billing/route fallback)
- Confluence: quick sample queries for token sampling (linked above)

End of sheet.
